metadata.short_desc: See what an AstrBot plugin can do, in one plugin.
metadata.desc: A full-surface AstrBot plugin example: config schema, event hooks, i18n, WebUI Page, LLM tools and persistent storage.

enabled.hint: When disabled, every command and message listener of this plugin stops responding.

log_level.hint: Applied to this plugin's own logger at load time; per-plugin loggers exist from AstrBot 4.26.8, on older versions the level is left untouched so the whole app is unaffected.

cooldown_seconds.hint: Minimum interval between two /showcase ping calls in the same session.

similarity_threshold.hint: 0-1. A keyword triggers once this share of it matches contiguously inside the message (typos tolerated); demonstrates custom_filter.

enabled_features.hint: Per-item switches: hooks = the 14 event hooks log; message = the rule listener; llm_tool = the LLM tool logs; web_api = the plugin page backend; storage = KV persistence; agent = the class-based LLM tool and the tool loop; push = the proactive push background task. Unchecked items are skipped.

keywords.hint: Free-form list: matching messages trigger the keyword rule.

chat_provider_id.hint: Used by /showcase ask, /showcase agent and the LLM tools. Leave empty to get a 'not configured' notice.

api_token.hint: Demonstrates the secret field: the input is masked, but the value is still stored in plain text. Never put real credentials here. Requires WebUI >= 4.28.0, otherwise it renders as a plain text box.

aliases.hint: Key/value pairs: /showcase say <alias> replies with the matching value. The preset editor requires WebUI >= 4.10.4.

hello.name: Example alias
hello.hint: The key is the alias, the value is the reply text.

manual_files.hint: Upload a file, then /showcase notes reads its first line; demonstrates the file type and the plugin data directory. The file_types filter requires WebUI >= 4.13.0.

max_lines.hint: Caps the output of /showcase config and /showcase notes; the summary is 15 lines, so a smaller value shows the truncation notice.

strict_mode.hint: When on, a failed rule match replies with a notice instead of staying silent.

rule_limit.hint: Only demonstrates the condition key: shown once strict mode is on. It takes part in no logic; /showcase config echoes its value.

debug_dump.hint: Demonstrates the invisible key: hidden in the WebUI but still kept in the config file; enabling it adds one more line to /showcase config.

rules.hint: Demonstrates template_list: each template has its own fields, chosen when adding an entry. Requires WebUI >= 4.10.4; the collapsed entry title requires >= 4.25.3.

keyword.name: Keyword rule
keyword.hint: Reply with fixed text when the message contains the keyword.

regex.name: Regex rule
regex.hint: Match the message with Python re syntax.

push_interval_seconds.hint: Interval of the proactive push loop, minimum 5 seconds. Takes effect after /showcase push on subscribes the current session.

session_timeout_seconds.hint: How long each step of /showcase wizard waits; the wizard ends on timeout.

agent_instruction.hint: System prompt used by the tool loop (/showcase agent); empty means the built-in example instruction.

cron_expression.hint: Expression used by /showcase cron add when no argument is given (minute hour day month weekday), e.g. */30 * * * * for every 30 minutes.

reply_prefix.hint: When set, on_decorating_result prepends it to every reply, demonstrating a hook that really rewrites the message chain (empty means no interference).

inject_context.hint: When on, on_llm_request appends one temporary context part (time / session / platform) to every request, demonstrating extra_user_content_parts + mark_as_temp (not stored in history, does not break the cache).

showcase.title: Capability Showcase
showcase.description: Demonstrates a plugin Page: iframe isolation, bridge calls, i18n and theme following.
showcase.heading: AstrBot plugin capabilities
showcase.subtitle: This page is rendered entirely from static files inside the plugin directory and talks to the plugin backend through window.AstrBotPluginPage.
showcase.empty: Use the buttons above to fire a bridge call.
showcase.bridge_note: The bridge also offers upload / download / subscribeSSE; see the plugin README.
